maddeler.e:
أختتم (form VIII)
# أَخْتَتِمُ (ʔaḵtatimu) /ʔax.ta.ti.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# أُخْتَتَمُ (ʔuḵtatamu) /ʔux.ta.ta.mu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# أَخْتَتِمَ (ʔaḵtatima) /ʔax.ta.ti.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# أُخْتَتَمَ (ʔuḵtatama) /ʔux.ta.ta
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
